packaged_browser_tests.scope: Direct Text in Compare/Edit Only; Concert labels, Undo/Redo, MusicXML and PDF; Alto/Soprano/Tenor labels; header addition/edit/deletion in both stages; drag position persistence and reimport; equal legacy/new Text deletion independently.

technical_review.notes: Explicit Text identities and revision-checked edits reviewed. Source remains read-only. No unrelated application files differ from the package baseline outside the bounded allowlist.

limitations: Three backend cases skipped by existing suite conditions; not counted as PASS.
No new general OMR accuracy certification.
External MusicXML applications may lay out custom header objects differently.
Build reports existing large bundle warnings; backend reports dependency deprecation warnings.
Old packages and running user sessions preserved.
